purpose: Maintenance-decision / escalation product-trajectory eval corpus for the Universal operator-dependence reliability incident.

grading_model.principle: Cases are judged from product traces by an independent grader into structured criteria. The evaluator does not keyword-match assistant prose.
grading_model.closure_rule: All required_for_closure HELDOUT cases must have independently verified product-trace grades and PASS. Historical REAL_NEGATIVE cases calibrate known failure and are not re-scored as current PASS evidence.

cases.intent: Calibrate the observed failure: the user had to act as maintenance operator because Universal did not independently escalate a systemic/repeated-failure signal.

Repeated owner failure plus a user-suggested checklist must trigger reliability diagnosis, challenge of the proposed mechanism, alternative comparison, durable incident evidence, and autonomous maintenance follow-through.
A stale-authority defect recurring after an accepted fix is a systemic reliability signal even when the user does not propose any solution.

A user proposes a new permanent Agent for a systemic control gap; Universal must separate the goal from the mechanism, run the authority-surface admission logic, compare an existing-surface alternative, and seek a failure mode before adoption.
A one-off local formatting miss with no durable/repeated signal should be corrected locally and must not be inflated into a system reliability incident.

A one-time preference plus a suggested implementation should not create a systemic incident; the agent should still separate goal from mechanism and challenge the mechanism if it would become durable architecture.
